captions.detailed: A 3D-printable parametric stackable utility box and its matching lid, shown side-by-side with flat, circular anti-warp helper discs at their outer corners. The box features a rectangular open compartment with a stepped, wider upper rim designed to mate with the lid or another box's base. The cover has a matching rectangular stepped profile to ensure a secure, nested fit when stacked.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric stackable box and matching cover in OpenSCAD. The design should include customizable variables for internal length, width, height, wall thickness, and stacking tolerances, along with optional, thin anti-warp circular ears at the corners for improved bed adhesion.
captions.factory: The script defines modular components: 'box' uses a difference of two cubes to create a hollow container; 'stackable_box' translates and unions a secondary larger rim box on top of the base box, utilizing a hull transition for support; 'stackable_box_cover' stacks two flat rectangular cubes of different sizes; and 'ears' uses cylinders with very small heights to place helper discs at the four outer corners of both the box and cover coordinates.
